review_scope.excluded_run_reason: r1 is failed/incomplete and r1b is superseded because its reset timing was not fully constrained; no timing, area or netlist number in this review is sourced from either excluded run

terminal_and_identity.version_probe_interpretation: The probe log identifies V-2023.12-SP3, but its nonzero return code is a receipt-quality defect and is not silently normalized to zero.

physical_contract.technology: TSMC 28nm HPC+ standard-cell libraries supplied in the exact snapshot
physical_contract.net_interconnect_area: undefined; ZeroWireload has zero net area

constraint_audit.rst_core_semantics: synchronous reset in the RTL and constrained as an ordinary data input
constraint_audit.constraint_violator_result: no max-delay, min-delay, max-capacitance, max-transition or max-fanout violated constraints

timing_results.hold_corner_note: The exact Tcl and log load the ffg DB and pair it as the min library. DC's report_timing header still prints the active ssg operating condition/library, so the pairing is auditable but should be made explicit in a PrimeTime MMMC receipt before paper PPA admission.

warning_audit.informational_power_characterization_gap: PWR-24 appears three times because TIEL/TIEH are not characterized for internal power; no power number is admitted
warning_audit.interpretation: No terminal synthesis or timing error was found. High-fanout delay approximation and ideal ZeroWireload remain pre-layout modeling limits, not timing failures.

admitted: the exact RTL snapshot maps to 9,939 TSMC 28nm standard cells with 0 macros/black boxes
cell-only area is 10,849.481934 um^2 under the stated library and ZeroWireload contract
reported standalone setup and hold slacks are +0.8967 ns and +0.0104 ns at a 3.000 ns clock under ideal-clock, logic-only constraints
rst_core is input-delay constrained and postcompile check_timing reports no missing-delay or unconstrained-endpoint warning
not_admitted: seed-SRAM feasibility, three-parent read bandwidth, banking, conflict, address, latency or traffic cost
Formality or independent mapped-netlist functional equivalence
SAIF/PTPX power, energy or energy efficiency
M57 integration, all10/full-network cycles, throughput, FPS or system speedup
paper-ready PPA or a Prosperity/Phi-level accelerator comparison

P1.finding: The standalone selector receives target plus three 256-bit parent operands at its boundary, but no seed-SRAM macro, banking, address generation, availability, conflicts, latency, bytes or energy is represented.
P1.impact: The dominant enabling cost can erase selector-local frequency or sparsity benefit and prevents memory-inclusive area, energy or speedup claims.
P1.minimal_fix: Freeze a banked seed-memory architecture and address-timed M53/M57 trace, then receipt legal left/up/previous availability, read ports, conflicts, bytes, latency and macro energy for every descriptor.

P1.finding: The run is ZeroWireload, ideal-clock and 0-macro DC synthesis; net interconnect area is undefined and there is no placement, routing, CTS, extraction or congestion evidence.
P1.impact: The 333 MHz target, positive slack and 0.010849 mm^2 cell area are preliminary logic-feasibility numbers, not paper-ready PPA.
P1.minimal_fix: Integrate real SRAM DB/LEF, floorplan and clocks, then run place/route and extracted multi-corner STA with congestion and macro-inclusive area.

P1.finding: DC reports sequential output inversion and explicitly requires the SVF for formal verification, but no Formality receipt is present.
P1.impact: The mapped 9,939-cell netlist is structurally auditable but not independently proven equivalent to the admitted RTL snapshot.
P1.minimal_fix: Run exact-SHA RTL-to-mapped Formality using the sealed SVF and publish pass/fail, unmatched/aborted points and tool/library identities.

P1.finding: No VCS SAIF, PrimeTime PX or activity-linked power report is sealed; PWR-24 also identifies uncharacterized internal power for tie cells.
P1.impact: No dynamic/leakage power, energy per descriptor or system energy benefit can be admitted.
P1.minimal_fix: Generate workload-linked SAIF on the exact mapped identity, run PTPX with coverage and macro power, and bind energy to the same all10 cycle/traffic ledger.

P1.finding: This is a standalone block run with no M57 instantiation, all10 replay, full-network cycles, accuracy or equal-resource Fixed/RQTB/Prosperity/Phi-like comparison.
P1.impact: Standalone positive timing cannot be converted into accelerator throughput, FPS, speedup, energy efficiency or DATE novelty claims.
P1.minimal_fix: Close all10 M64-to-M57 transaction/cycle equivalence and compare selector-inclusive system cycles, traffic, area, frequency, power and accuracy under one resource/memory model.

P2.finding: The Tcl/log audibly pair ffg as min_library, but the min-delay report header displays the active ssg operating condition/library.
P2.minimal_fix: Add report_lib/report_operating_conditions or PrimeTime MMMC evidence that explicitly prints max and min library pairing beside the worst hold path.

P2.finding: dc.version.raw.log identifies V-2023.12-SP3 but dc.version.rc is 1.
P2.minimal_fix: Make the version probe accept the tool's intentional exit behavior or query version inside the successful Tcl, then seal an unambiguous successful tool-identity receipt.

P2.finding: TIM-134 uses fanout 1000 for one or two high-fanout nets during timing calculations.
P2.minimal_fix: Identify those nets, apply realistic drive/buffering and validate their delay after placement/CTS instead of relying on WLM approximation.

P2.finding: PWR-24/PWR-536 note TIEL/TIEH internal-power characterization gaps, although only TIEH remains in the mapped netlist.
P2.minimal_fix: Use a complete power library or document/exclude the negligible tie-cell contribution explicitly in PTPX.

P2.finding: Only a 3.000 ns target is sealed; there is no clock sweep, voltage/temperature sweep or post-layout margin study.
P2.minimal_fix: Publish a constrained frequency/corner sweep and use the same integrated design point for all baseline comparisons.

P2.finding: r1 is failed/incomplete and r1b is superseded by r1c because reset timing was not fully constrained; mixing their artifacts can recreate a false timing admission.
P2.minimal_fix: Keep r1/r1b mechanically excluded from paper tables and bind every M64 DC number to the r1c output-manifest SHA.

must_pass: address-timed seed-SRAM parent-read architecture with macro-inclusive cost
exact-SHA Formality on the mapped netlist
workload-linked SAIF/PTPX plus explicit MMMC min/max library evidence
M64-integrated M57 all10 transaction and cycle replay
same-resource end-to-end speed, energy, area, accuracy and Prosperity/Phi-like baselines
